content: Standard GitHub Actions pattern to publish to GHCR: docker/login-action@v3 with registry ghcr.io and the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN (no extra secret needed for same-repo publishing), docker/metadata-action@v5 to generate tags/labels, docker/build-push-action@v6 with push: true and buildx for layer caching (cache-from/cache-to type=gha). Images resolve to ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>. Needs 'permissions: packages: write' on the job.
